Strong: 11,372 and a clear stake on the cover itself; every slide earns its place, with each fact said once and attributed ('DoT data obtained by The Hindu under RTI'); a genuine own-life question; a credited CC BY 4.0 Commons photo, framed full-bleed with the tower clear of the logo and headline.
